name: Interface Cheat Sheet
summary: Concise UI design cheat sheet: practical rules for interface, animation, typography, colors, accessibility, layout and writing.
description: One page of practical interface guidelines with interactive before/after demos, grouped into seven sections: User Interface, Animation, Typography, Colors, Accessibility, Layout and Writing. Covers concentric border radius, optical alignment, enter/exit animation and reduced motion, woff2 and text-wrap, semantic color tokens, focus-visible, hit areas, labels, and link and button wording. Includes an agent-readable index.md version and links to the paid Interfaces magazine.
